posts.title: SR-22 same day
posts.text:
DUI? Tickets? Suspended license? We've got you. ✅

Speedy Insurance files SR-22s SAME DAY — and we accept ALL drivers, no matter the record. Four offices across the Inland Empire, open Mon–Fri 9am–7pm and Saturdays 10am–5pm.

Walk in, call, or get your free quote online today. 🚗

posts.title: SR-22 mismo día
posts.text:
¿DUI? ¿Tickets? ¿Licencia suspendida? Lo tenemos cubierto. ✅

Speedy Insurance presenta su SR-22 EL MISMO DÍA — y aceptamos a TODOS los conductores, sin importar su historial. Cuatro oficinas en el Inland Empire, abiertos Lun–Vie 9am–7pm y Sábados 10am–5pm.

Visítenos, llámenos, o pida su cotización gratis hoy. 🚗

posts.title: DMV services
posts.text:
Skip the DMV line! 🎉

Registration renewals, title transfers, VIN verifications and more — handled right in our offices while you take care of your insurance. One stop, no appointment needed.

Open Mon–Fri 9am–7pm · Sat 10am–5pm. Visit any of our four Inland Empire locations.

posts.title: Servicios DMV
posts.text:
¡Olvídese de las filas del DMV! 🎉

Renovación de registración, transferencia de título, verificación de VIN y más — directamente en nuestras oficinas mientras arregla su seguro. Todo en un solo lugar, sin cita.

Abierto Lun–Vie 9am–7pm · Sáb 10am–5pm. Visite cualquiera de nuestras cuatro oficinas.

posts.title: Evenings & Saturdays
posts.text:
Your day doesn't end at 5 — neither does ours. 🕘

Speedy Insurance is open until 7pm Monday through Friday, and Saturdays 10am–5pm. Evenings and weekends, walk in, call, or chat with us on our website.

Real agents, real answers — English y español.

posts.title: Tardes y sábados
posts.text:
Su día no termina a las 5 — el nuestro tampoco. 🕘

Speedy Insurance está abierto hasta las 7pm de lunes a viernes, y los sábados de 10am a 5pm. Por las tardes y los fines de semana: visítenos, llámenos, o chatee con nosotros en nuestro sitio web.

Agentes de verdad, respuestas de verdad — hablamos español.

posts.title: Open Sundays
posts.text:
Open SUNDAYS in Moreno Valley! 🚗

Our Moreno Valley office at 12625 Frederick St #I-1 is open Sundays 10am–5pm — insurance, same-day SR-22 filings, and DMV services when almost everyone else is closed.

Call (951) 472-0927 or just walk in.

posts.title: Abierto los domingos
posts.text:
¡Abierto los DOMINGOS en Moreno Valley! 🚗

Nuestra oficina de Moreno Valley en 12625 Frederick St #I-1 abre los domingos de 10am a 5pm — seguros, SR-22 el mismo día, y servicios del DMV cuando casi todos están cerrados.

Llame al (951) 472-0927 o simplemente visítenos.

posts.title: Free quote CTA
posts.text:
How much could you be saving on car insurance? 💰

Free quote in minutes — no obligation, no pressure. We shop 20+ carriers to find your best rate, including SR-22, DUI and non-standard drivers other agencies turn away.

Call, walk in, or start online. Mon–Fri 9am–7pm · Sat 10am–5pm.

posts.title: Cotización gratis
posts.text:
¿Cuánto podría ahorrar en su seguro de auto? 💰

Cotización gratis en minutos — sin compromiso y sin presión. Comparamos más de 20 aseguradoras para encontrar su mejor tarifa, incluyendo SR-22, DUI y conductores que otras agencias rechazan.

Llame, visítenos, o empiece en línea. Lun–Vie 9am–7pm · Sáb 10am–5pm.

replies.title: 5-star — general
replies.text: Thank you so much for the kind words, [Name]! We're glad we could help. If you ever need anything — insurance, SR-22, or DMV — we're here. 🚗

replies.title: 5-star — agent mentioned by name
replies.text: Thank you, [Name]! We'll be sure [Agent] hears this — they'll be thrilled. Thank you for trusting Speedy Insurance, and we're here whenever you need us.

replies.title: 5-star — SR-22 / DUI mentioned
replies.text: Thank you, [Name]! Getting drivers back on the road quickly is what we do — same-day SR-22 filings, no judgment. We appreciate you choosing Speedy Insurance.

replies.title: 5-star — price / savings mentioned
replies.text: Thank you, [Name]! Shopping 20+ carriers to find the best rate is exactly the point. Glad we could save you money — see you at renewal!

replies.title: 5 estrellas — respuesta en español
replies.text: ¡Muchas gracias por sus amables palabras, [Name]! Nos alegra mucho haberle ayudado. Si necesita algo más — seguro, SR-22, o servicios del DMV — aquí estamos para servirle. 🚗

replies.title: 4-star — good but not perfect
replies.text: Thank you for the review, [Name]! We're glad we could help — and we'd love to hear what would have made it a 5-star experience. Feel free to call your branch anytime. We appreciate you!

replies.title: 3-star or unclear
replies.text: Thank you for the feedback, [Name]. We want every visit to be a 5-star one — please call us at (951) 472-0927 and ask for the branch manager so we can hear what happened and make it right.

replies.title: 1–2 star — negative (escalate to Saif, do not auto-post)
replies.text: Hi [Name], we're sorry your experience wasn't what it should have been. We take this seriously and want to make it right. Please call us at (951) 472-0927 and ask for the branch manager — or if you prefer, reply with the best way to reach you. — Speedy Insurance Management

replies.title: Suspected fake (escalate to Saif, do not auto-post)
replies.text: Hi [Name], we take all feedback seriously, but we can't locate any record of your visit or policy with us. Please contact us at (951) 472-0927 so we can look into this — we'd like to resolve any genuine concern. — Speedy Insurance Management
